import math
import random

def calculate_sum(adj, degrees):
    n = len(adj)
    s = 0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if adj[i][j]:
                s += abs(degrees[i] - degrees[j])
    return s

def simulated_annealing(n, temp=10.0, cooling_rate=0.9995, iterations=100000):
    adj = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if random.random() < 0.3:
                adj[i][j] = adj[j][i] = 1
    
    degrees = [sum(row) for row in adj]
    current_s = calculate_sum(adj, degrees)
    
    best_s = current_s
    best_adj = [row[:] for row in adj]
    
    for i in range(iterations):
        u = random.randint(0, n - 1)
        v = random.randint(0, n - 1)
        if u == v: continue
        if u > v: u, v = v, u
        
        # Flip edge (u, v)
        old_du = degrees[u]
        old_dv = degrees[v]
        
        if adj[u][v] == 0:
            adj[u][v] = adj[v][u] = 1
            degrees[u] += 1
            degrees[v] += 1
        else:
            adj[u][v] = adj[v][u] = 0
            degrees[u] -= 1
            degrees[v] -= 1
        
        new_s = calculate_sum(adj, degrees)
        
        delta = new_s - current_s
        if delta > 0 or math.exp(delta / temp) > random.random():
            current_s = new_s
            if current_s > best_s:
                best_s = current_s
                best_adj = [row[:] for row in adj]
        else:
            # Backtrack
            if adj[u][v] == 1:
                adj[u][v] = adj[v][u] = 0
                degrees[u] -= 1
                degrees[v] -= 1
            else:
                adj[u][v] = adj[v][u] = 1
                degrees[u] += 1
                degrees[v] += 1
        
        temp *= cooling_rate
        if temp < 0.001:
            temp = 1.0 # Reheat

    return best_s, best_adj

n = 11
best_s = 0
for _ in range(20):
    s, adj = simulated_annealing(n)
    if s > best_s:
        best_s = s

print(f"Best sum found: {best_s}")
